transparent: true\" visible=\"false\" ></a-box> <!-- Model --> <a-gltf-model id=\"model\" src=\"#jsModelAsset\" position=\"0 0 0\" rotation=\"180 90 90\" scale=\"3 3 3\" visible=\"false\" ></a-gltf-model> </a-entity> <!-- Video --> <a-video id=\"video\" src=\"#jsVideoAsset\" position=\"0 0 0\" rotation=\"0 0 0\" width=\"1.5\" height=\"1\" visible=\"false\" ></a-video> </a-entity> </a-scene> <script> const startButton = document.querySelector(\"#startButton\"); const overlay = document.querySelector(\"#overlay\"); const target = document.querySelector(\"#target\"); const model = document.querySelector(\"#model\"); const hitbox = document.querySelector(\"#hitbox\"); const video = document.querySelector(\"#video\"); const videoAsset = document.querySelector(\"#jsVideoAsset\"); model.addEventListener('model-loaded', () => { const mesh = model.getObject3D('mesh'); mesh.traverse((node) => { if (node.isMesh) { // This prevents the \"disappearing act\" when moving the phone node.frustumCulled = false; // Ensure the material is actually treating transparency correctly node.material.depthWrite = true; } }); }); // Start AR startButton.addEventListener(\"click\", () => { overlay.style.display = \"none\"; }); // Target found target.addEventListener(\"targetFound\", () => { model.setAttribute(\"visible\", true); hitbox.setAttribute(\"visible\", true); }); // Target lost target.addEventListener(\"targetLost\", () => { model.setAttribute(\"visible\", false); hitbox.setAttribute(\"visible\", false); video.setAttribute(\"visible\", false); videoAsset.pause(); }); // Tap hitbox → show video hitbox.addEventListener(\"click\", () => { video.setAttribute(\"visible\", true); videoAsset.play(); }); </script> </body> </html>\\E$"}
